summary: The agent successfully sets up a LightGBM model with cross-validation but introduces critical data leakage during preprocessing. Specifically, the agent applies median imputation to the entire training set before splitting into cross-validation folds, and also incorrectly imputes the test set using test set medians rather than training set medians.
